# `passportsim snapshot`

Save, restore, list, fork, export and import instance state.

| MCP tool | Scenario step | macOS | Windows | Browser |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `passport_snapshot` | `snapshot` | yes | yes | yes |

## Synopsis

```text
passportsim snapshot <op> [name] [--confirm <CONFIRM>] [--count <COUNT>] [--include-secrets] [--instance <INSTANCE>] [--path <PATH>] [--vary-seed] [--json <@file|->]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Form | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `confirm` | `--confirm <CONFIRM>` | `string` | no | Human confirmation code. |
| `count` | `--count <COUNT>` | `integer` | no | Forks to create (1). |
| `include_secrets` | `--include-secrets` | `boolean` | no | Export unredacted; needs `confirm`. |
| `instance` | `--instance <INSTANCE>` | `string` | no | Instance id. |
| `name` | `<name>` | `string` | no | Snapshot name. |
| `op` | `<op>` | `"save"` \| `"restore"` \| `"load"` \| `"list"` \| `"delete"` \| `"fork"` \| `"export"` \| `"import"` | yes | What to do. |
| `path` | `--path <PATH>` | `string` | no | Artifact path, relative and forward-slashed. |
| `vary_seed` | `--vary-seed` | `boolean` | no | Give each fork its own seed. |

A nested object or array is passed as one JSON document with `--json @<file>` or `--json -`; it has no flag of its own.

## Errors

`E_USAGE` (1), `E_STATE` (2), `E_LEASE` (6), `E_SNAPSHOT` (15), `E_SECRET_REFUSED` (16), `E_INTERNAL` (17). What each means: [errors.md](../errors.md).

## Examples

### Save the current state under a name

```sh
passportsim snapshot --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "name": "menu",
  "op": "save"
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "name": "menu",
  "op": "save"
}
'@ | passportsim snapshot --json -
```

### List what this instance has saved

```sh
passportsim snapshot --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "op": "list"
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "op": "list"
}
'@ | passportsim snapshot --json -
```

### Fork 16 instances from the settled menu, each with its own seed

```sh
passportsim snapshot --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "count": 16,
  "name": "menu",
  "op": "fork",
  "vary_seed": true
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "count": 16,
  "name": "menu",
  "op": "fork",
  "vary_seed": true
}
'@ | passportsim snapshot --json -
```

### Export a redacted snapshot as an artifact

```sh
passportsim snapshot --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "name": "menu",
  "op": "export"
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "name": "menu",
  "op": "export"
}
'@ | passportsim snapshot --json -
```

### Import a snapshot an export wrote

```sh
passportsim snapshot --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "name": "menu",
  "op": "import"
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "name": "menu",
  "op": "import"
}
'@ | passportsim snapshot --json -
```
